result.title: SynCalib: Breaking Dataset Shortcuts in LiDAR-Camera Calibration via Extrinsic-Controllable Synthesis
result.summary: Online LiDAR-camera calibration remains a fundamental yet challenging task in the field of robotics. Recently, deep learning-based data-driven approaches have emerged, offering high-precision, targetless calibration capabilities. However, existing methods often suffer from a critical dataset shortcut phenomenon due to the lack of extrinsic diversity in their training data. Networks tend to overfit to fixed nominal extrinsic configurations, leading to severe performance degradation and poor generalization in real-world deployments. To address this limitation, we propose a highly generalizable data generation framework tailored for training LiDAR-camera calibration networks. Our framework leverages existing omnidirectional image datasets annotated with depth ground truth to synthesize multi-modal calibration data under rigorous extrinsic constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the data generated by our pipeline significantly enhances the generalization and robustness of typical learning-based calibration networks. Furthermore, we conduct comprehensive real-world evaluations across various camera-LiDAR configurations, validating the zero-shot transfer capability of models trained exclusively on our synthetic data. To facilitate future research and community use, the code for data generation, the pre-trained models, and online benchmark datasets will be made publicly available.

AI.brief_summary: 针对 LiDAR-相机在线标定网络因训练数据中外参多样性不足而过度拟合标称外参、泛化差的问题，提出利用带深度真值的全向图像数据集在严格外参约束下合成多模态标定数据的生成框架，并验证其提升标定网络鲁棒性、支持零样本迁移。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「数据捷径」诊断与通过可控合成外参打破捷径的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉旁路、模型忽略视觉证据而依赖先验的监督与数据设计提供核查线索，但任务本身是几何标定回归，与 latent 推理状态无直接联系。
